title: Milestone 1 Deliverables Client Approval Pending
description: Final sign-off on System Requirements Plan and Architecture Specification delayed by 12 days awaiting legal review.
actionPlan: Convene emergency review board with customer commercial leads to unblock formal sign-off.

title: Primary Data Center Optical Interconnect Delivery Hold
description: Hardware provider notified of 14-day hold on custom fiber patch panels for Facility E.01.
actionPlan: Deploy temporary high-density pre-terminated cabling harness to enable test/dev onboarding.

title: Independent Cyber Assessor Telemetry Access Delay
description: ATO-C assessor security clearances undergoing final validation before audit portal login is provisioned.
actionPlan: Deliver offline redacted compliance evidence pack and schedule in-person audit walkthrough.

title: GPU Training Node Thermal Throttling in Rack 4
description: High-density compute chassis exhaust temp exceeded 42°C threshold under sustained FP8 matrix training.
actionPlan: Rebalance workload across Adjacent Rack 5 and increase rear-door heat exchanger coolant flow rate.

title: CDC Data Pipeline Ingestion Backlog on Legacy Sybase Tables
description: Sybase database replication log reader falling behind by 45 minutes during nightly batch reconciliation.
actionPlan: Implement partitioned parallel read streams and optimize Sybase transaction log segment allocation.

title: Cross-Domain Proxy TLS Handshake Renegotiation Failure
description: Certain legacy client SDKs failing handshake when TLS 1.3 session tickets expire.
actionPlan: Updated envoy proxy TLS configuration to permit session resumption fallback.

title: Automated Test Harness Flakiness in Multi-Region Mesh Probers
description: Synthetic probers reporting false packet drop alerts due to test runner CPU starvation.
actionPlan: Allocated dedicated guaranteed CPU cores to test runner worker daemonsets.

title: Contractual Scope Baseline Misalignment for CD1.5 Gateway
description: Differing interpretations of sovereign enclave data boundary requirements between steering groups.
actionPlan: Formalize System Requirements Review (SRR) glide path to align milestone definitions.

title: Vector Search Shard Rebalancing Latency Spike
description: Live re-indexing causes temporary 200ms latency increase for interactive analyst query sessions.
actionPlan: Schedule vector shard defragmentation and re-indexing exclusively during off-peak maintenance windows.

title: Enclave Monitoring Agent CPU Utilization Above 3% SLA
description: eBPF security prober consuming 4.2% CPU on edge ingress nodes.
actionPlan: Filter unmonitored socket events at kernel level to reduce ring buffer dispatch frequency.

title: Object Storage S3 Gateway Multi-Part Upload Timeout
description: Large dataset archive uploads (>50GB) timing out on slow sovereign edge connections.
actionPlan: Increase chunk upload timeout and enable client-side adaptive chunk sizing.
